dogecoin.text: dogecoin's rise from meme to influence is a case study in social media's power over markets. elon backing it under trump adds a layer of political intrigue. watch closely.

dogecoin's volatility and media narratives are a sideshow. the real story lies in its concentrated token distribution—top wallets hold a disproportionate share. decentralization is key to crypto’s integrity, not media spins.
